name: omniverse-bridge
description: OmniMemo agent cards, context usage reporting and opt-in fresh-context rollover for Claude Code.

rollover.title: Context rollover
rollover.description: suggest: tells you when context is high, and /om-rollover hands off. auto: at the threshold, runs /clear and continues this work in a fresh conversation from the saved OmniMemo handoff. off: reports usage only.

rolloverAt.title: Rollover at (percent)
rolloverAt.description: Context usage (percent) at which to hand off; default 80.

prepareAt.title: Prepare checkpoint at (percent)
prepareAt.description: Context usage (percent) at which a checkpoint is saved ahead of the handoff; default 70.

omPath.title: Path to om
omPath.description: The om command the plugin runs directly (not through a shell); the installer sets it to the installed binary.
